trans-unit.resname: Sends page views and completed orders to Google Analytics 4.
trans-unit.source: Sends page views and completed orders to Google Analytics 4.
trans-unit.target: Wysyła odsłony stron i złożone zamówienia do Google Analytics 4.

trans-unit.resname: Google Analytics shows it under Admin, Data streams, your web stream. It looks like G-XXXXXXXXXX.
trans-unit.source: Google Analytics shows it under Admin, Data streams, your web stream. It looks like G-XXXXXXXXXX.
trans-unit.target: Znajdziesz go w Google Analytics w Administracja, Strumienie danych, Twój strumień internetowy. Ma postać G-XXXXXXXXXX.

trans-unit.resname: Turn this off to stop the tracking without clearing the measurement ID.
trans-unit.source: Turn this off to stop the tracking without clearing the measurement ID.
trans-unit.target: Wyłącz, aby wstrzymać zbieranie danych bez usuwania identyfikatora pomiaru.

trans-unit.resname: Marks every hit as a debug hit so it shows up in the DebugView report. Keep it off in production.
trans-unit.source: Marks every hit as a debug hit so it shows up in the DebugView report. Keep it off in production.
trans-unit.target: Oznacza każde trafienie jako diagnostyczne, dzięki czemu widać je w raporcie DebugView. Na produkcji trzymaj to wyłączone.

trans-unit.resname: The measurement ID must look like G-XXXXXXXXXX.
trans-unit.source: The measurement ID must look like G-XXXXXXXXXX.
trans-unit.target: Identyfikator pomiaru musi mieć postać G-XXXXXXXXXX.

trans-unit.resname: Add a measurement ID before you turn the tracking on.
trans-unit.source: Add a measurement ID before you turn the tracking on.
trans-unit.target: Dodaj identyfikator pomiaru, zanim włączysz zbieranie danych.
